title: The practice's skills say what for in their descriptions, speak the pattern's terms in their bodies, and hold every concept to its Cratylic name
situation: Code review of 0333's change found the skills contradicting themselves: the descriptions and the restated principle give every concept its Cratylic name, confirmed by a cold read, as cratylic context design holds, while signify, exemplify and formalize still limit naming and the cold read to cratylus's own core agent dimension names and values, which in a user's project excludes every concept; materialize writes a primitive concept with its whole meaning beside its term, where the design states only its correction; and two citations credit the design with symbols it does not define.
decision: As 0333, with the bodies' limit and materialize's form aligned too. (1) Each skill's description states in plain words what the skill is for and when an agent reaches for it, in the pattern's terms (term, Cratylic name, semantic gap, missing and spurious meaning, correction, cold read), with no notation and nothing of how cratylus builds or renders it. (2) Each body keeps its formal statement and procedure, its terms aligned: residue becomes the semantic gap where a name is judged and the correction where a concept enters a text beside its term, cited to cratylic context design; the cold-decode oracle becomes the cold read; sign and signifier meaning a name become term. A citation to cratylic context design is made only for what the design defines (the semantic gap, the correction, the cold read), never for a skill's own symbols. (3) The limit to core agent dimension names and values goes from every body: signify names every concept its text carries, a concept its domain already names taking that established term, found and never coined, its cold read confirming it; exemplify keeps a piece only when the cold read of the terms it carries confirms them; formalize names every entity and operation by its term through signify. (4) materialize writes a primitive concept as its term with its correction, the term alone where the correction is empty, never restating what the term carries. (5) The prime principle restates cratylism as the design holds it, citing no residue, oracle or core limit. Corpus and the canon's other unit words, and the agents' stances, stay for their own work.
consequences: Supersedes 0333. The descriptions, the principle and the bodies tell one story in a user's project as in cratylus's own. One builder; review Ask.
